description: Minimal permissions for the main Chapbook window, deliberately narrowed from core:default. The app registers no custom Tauri commands, so only the core app/window/event essentials the shell uses, the opener (system-browser external links) and the HTTP plugin are granted. The HTTP scope is the native fetch bridge (src/lib/nativeFetch.js): it is restricted to exactly the CSP connect-src hosts the frontend calls, so the Rust client can reach GitHub, the AI providers, the R2/Worker media hosts and the device-flow relay — and nothing else. Keep this allow-list in lockstep with the bundle-local CSP connect-src.
